subject: QA Risk Brief — 2026-02-23
body:
GR — QA risk brief from this sprint.

## Re-verification results (from your blockers-resolved request)

- cross-exam-verify.js: PASS — 0 hard failures (was 32 at audit start)
- verify-practice-exams.js: PASS — 2687/2687
- lint-math-json.js: 1 residual E-5 error found (rp8-q15, 123 chars). Fixed and committed. Now 0 errors, 36 W-1.

All 3 blockers confirmed resolved. Baseline is clean.

## Risks for GR (question math quality)

1. question-type-coverage.test.js now enforces type floors:
   - exponential >= 15, quadratic >= 8, radical >= 10, rational >= 6, graph >= 12, word-problem >= 6
   If you add new exams or replace questions, do not let any type drop below floor.

2. question-schema.test.js: 5 failures on missing 'source_file' field in legacy questions (w2w3-*). Also 4 multi-standard assignments ('5.b & 5.c') not in standards.json. These are GI/GR territory.

3. cross-exam W-3 warnings: Q9 answers too close (retake-practice-6=3.5 vs retake-practice-8=4, delta=0.50). Within tolerance but worth tracking if Kai memorizes these.

## What I need from you

If you add RP10+, run verify-practice-exams.js and cross-exam-verify.js before committing. Also consider adding 'source_file' to new question entries — it's required by question-schema.test.js.
